For now, higher price pressures globally may keep the central bank from needing to take any immediate action.

However, a stronger Swiss franc currency will continue to pile on the pressure in the bigger picture.

As such, the Swiss central bank cannot rest on its laurels in pushing back against such strength in the currency.
